limits: Only owned generateStereo exists; no borrowed/Into/read/status/IRQ/setClock APIs are claimed. Register effects are read from the real exported state format and independently observed in positive PCM controls.

Same-instance public opaque tokens include ROM, addresses, mute and native integration state. Bounded trusted raw cross-build states use identical configurations. Native loader length checks are tested; arbitrary same-sized field fuzzing is excluded.

ROM clear does not disable voices: missing data reads byte0 then unsigned bias produces sample -128. Already held native samples persist until the next tick. Reset retains ROM and mute bits and clears voices/integration.

No browser, Worklet scheduling, Native/Tauri backend, Mixer, physical hardware or listening judgement is tested.
